summary: Move root compatibility imports to the canonical cdk, core, kit, addon-grid, addon-charts, patterns, or testing owner.
after:
import { KrnButton } from '@kern-ui/angular/kit';
import { KrnDataGrid } from '@kern-ui/angular/addon-grid';

to: KrnSwitch.checkedChange with checked/checkedChange two-way binding, or Angular Forms
summary: Name Switch state after the native checked property. Use checkedChange for standalone state, or keep formControl/ngModel as the single owner when Angular Forms is present.

to: Primary and secondary content declared in the intended reading and focus order
summary: Remove reverseCollapsed and keep the visual panel sequence aligned with DOM, assistive-technology, and keyboard focus order. If secondary content must precede primary content, declare it as primary content and choose the matching ratio.
before:
<krn-split-layout reverseCollapsed>
  <main krnSplitPrimary>Primary</main>
  <aside krnSplitSecondary>Secondary first when stacked</aside>
</krn-split-layout>
after:
<krn-split-layout ratio="1:2">
  <aside krnSplitPrimary>Secondary first in every reading mode</aside>
  <main krnSplitSecondary>Primary second in every reading mode</main>
</krn-split-layout>

from: KrnFormField id, required, disabled, readonly, and state inputs
to: The projected control id/native state and its Angular FormControl status
summary: Keep Form Field as a label, layout, and description coordinator. Move control identity and required/readonly state to the projected control, disable reactive controls through FormControl.disable(), and represent invalid/pending/valid through the real Angular control or mounted error content.
after:
<krn-form-field
  label="Workspace name"
  [error]="visibleError"
>
  <krn-text-input
    id="workspace-name"
    required
    [readonly]="locked"
    [formControl]="control"
  />
</krn-form-field>

// Disable the Angular model and native control together.
if (saving) control.disable();
else control.enable();
